SELECT d.id, d.title, d.version, d.status, d.audit_status, d.visibility, d.author_id, d.team_id, d.view_count, d.like_count, d.favorite_count, d.reject_reason, d.created_at, d.updated_at, u.username AS author_name, t.name AS team_name FROM document d LEFT JOIN user u ON d.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN team t ON d.team_id = t.id WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR d.status = #{status}) AND (#{auditStatus} IS NULL OR d.audit_status=#{auditStatus}) -- 动态条件 AND (#{auditStatus} IS NULL OR d.audit_status = #{auditStatus}) AND (#{title} IS NULL OR d.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')) AND (#{authorName} IS NULL OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{authorName}, '%')) AND (#{teamId} IS NULL OR d.team_id = #{teamId}) AND (#{startTime} IS NULL OR d.created_at > #{startTime}) AND (#{endTime} IS NULL OR d.created_at < #{endTime}) ORDER BY d.created_at DESC

SELECT -- 文档相关统计 COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS total_documents, SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS published_documents, SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draft_documents, SUM(CASE WHEN d.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS archived_documents,
-- 收藏数量 COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) AS total_favorites,
-- 评论数量 COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_comments,
-- 团队数量 COUNT(DISTINCT tm.team_id) AS total_teams
FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN `document` d ON d.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `favorite` f ON f.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `comment` c ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `team_member` tm ON tm.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{authorId}

select count(*) as total_documents, sum(like_count) as total_likes, sum(view_count) as total_views, (select count(*) from comment c where c.document_id in (select id from document where author_id = #{authorId}) ) as total_received_comments from document d where d.author_id = #{authorId}
select sum(IF(status = 0, 1, 0)) draft, sum(IF(status = 1, 1, 0)) published, sum(IF(status = 2, 1, 0)) archived from document where author_id = #{authorId}

select sum(IF(audit_status = 0, 1, 0)) editing, sum(IF(audit_status = 1, 1, 0)) pending, sum(IF(audit_status = 2, 1, 0)) approved, sum(IF(audit_status = 3, 1, 0)) rejectrd from document where author_id =#{authorId}
select sum(IF(visibility = 0, 1, 0)) private_count, sum(IF(visibility = 1, 1, 0)) team, sum(IF(visibility = 2, 1, 0)) public_count from document where author_id = #{authorId}
